pr_title: session: fix auto commit variable change effect on transaction commit
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #36581 

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

When changing the value of the session variable `auto-commit`, the implicit commit for ongoing transactions should happen only when it's changed from off to on. 


### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test

Side effects



Documentation


### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
Fix the auto-commit mode change related transaction commit behaviours.
```

issue_context.title: autocommit handles process issues
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
set autocommit = ON;
begin;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select * from test.t1;
+-----+
| id  |
+-----+
| 590 |
+-----+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)

mysql> update test.t1 set id = id+1;
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.00 sec)
Rows matched: 1  Changed: 1  Warnings: 0

mysql> select * from test.t1;
+-----+
| id  |
+-----+
| 591 |
+-----+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)

mysql> set autocommit = ON;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> rollback;
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
consistent with mysql
select * from test.t1;
+-----+
| id  |
+-----+
| 590 |
+-----+
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
select * from test.t1;
+-----+
| id  |
+-----+
| 591 |
+-----+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
